purpose: Read-only B4 test scope and shared-test review

runner.sevenDayRouteKind: headless protocol simulation; ocean travel is a test double

relevantCases: built-in timer advances with the ocean, blocks steering, and pauses for UI
barrel completion at night end commits once, while unfinished work cancels free
false is a valid disabled result while rejection and exceptions fail readback
barrel uses its built-in timer and exposes cancel without an instant-finish control
saving rejects duplicate confirmation and explicit skip ignores late callbacks
new run immediately writes a reset snapshot before releasing the entry pause
formal scene defaults to clientCloud read and blocks entry until a choice
new-run initial save can retry or explicitly continue without waiting
scene Stop accepts A's false disabled result and closes the real scope
formal HUD save failure explicitly retries or abandons without double settlement
explicitly skipping a failed save releases one settlement without pretending to save
a save retry in flight can be explicitly skipped and ignores its late callback
new run resets gameplay and immediately saves its starting snapshot

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: net includes its eight-meter boundary and a single cast catches only one fish
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: outdated fixture assumption around delayed landing and moving fish; not enough evidence for product bug
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Test inclusive/exclusive geometry directly, then separately use a stable in-range catch fixture to test landing, timer and one-fish semantics.

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: new-day world refresh waits for save success and retry is idempotent
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: fixture starts ship at (-20,-20) while marking loop inPort=true; port is (0,0), 28.3m away
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Start settlement fixture at the real port coordinate and preserve retry/idempotency assertions.

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: explicit unsaved continuation refreshes the sea once and releases settlement pause
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: same physically inconsistent inPort fixture; save-skip path is not reached
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Start at the real port and preserve world-refresh, skip, and late-callback assertions.

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: Scene starts one B HUD over A renderer and shows offline status without legacy HUD
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: old static notice ID was removed; test also disables loadSaved, bypassing current formal entry/load-error path
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Exercise the default entry read with an unavailable cloud backend and assert visible load failure/retry/new-run choice before entry is released.

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: Scene ticks B once, gates pointer input immediately and records the sea pointer drop target
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: fixture is not development mode; current Scene creates SeaDebug only for development=true
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Use development=true in debug-specific harness; keep production cheat-hiding assertion in Circle1B3SceneUITests.

sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.name: Scene offline store returns a clear error and never touches cloud or auto-loads
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.assessment: prior Scene test departs from (-20,-20), then calls normal ReturnToPort without travelling within 10m
sixCurrentSharedAbFailures.minimalFix: Simulate movement into the 10m port interaction radius, then retain the no-cloud-call assertion; do not reset/teleport for normal return.

recommendation.keepCurrentSharedContracts: Keep the current timed fishing and current entry/port assertions as reviewed shared tests if accepted; preserve the A originals and historical protection hashes unchanged.
recommendation.restore: Do not blindly restore the two A originals on top of the current product because instant-fishing and old port assumptions conflict with the current confirmed behavior. Restore exact A hashes only after extracting incompatible assertions and when running them as historical/compatible A evidence.
recommendation.independentMigration: If file ownership must be isolated, migrate current B4-specific timer/lock/full-hold cases and entry/save/scope/HUD cases into B4-specific suites, with an explicit 8m geometry case and real travel-to-port fixture; keep nonconflicting Architecture cases in the current shared coverage.
recommendation.baseline: Never rewrite a-protection.json or historical baseline hashes to hide the reviewed shared-file delta.

postReviewFinalState.source: root task follow-up message, after B4 regression snapshot
postReviewFinalState.inputFlowFinding: Select an item with BeginThrowItem(1) before sea pointer drop; a normal pointer click only sets navigation target.
